svg.title: Syn-owned CI and explicit Potbot compatibility
svg.desc: Syn push and pull request events run Linux application tests, a disposable PostgreSQL service and a portable client wheel matrix. A manual workflow tests an exact reviewed Potbot commit with the exact Syn candidate. Potbot retains its independent full acceptance and custody checks. Configured jobs are not proof of successful execution.

g.text: Syn owns its verification. Potbot verifies its consumption.
Workflow design · every result belongs to an exact source revision
Push / pull request → read-only jobs, locked dependencies, synthetic fixtures
SHA-pinned actions · no persistent checkout credentials · no private-source cache publishing
Manual compatibility: reviewed Potbot SHA + exact Syn candidate SHA
Consumer policy, exchange and custody-evidence tests; no automatic consumer branch or gitlink change.
Potbot retains its own complete application, PostgreSQL, sandbox and native-custody checks.
Later gates: real encrypted Agent mesh → qualified agreement adapters → fault and recovery matrices
Generated configuration illustration · run status and actual acceptance evidence must be verified independently.
